ProTOML Low-Level API

ProTOML includes 40 low-level DLL API functions for direct or specialized integrations.

The global template and high-level Clarion wrapper are the normal interface. Most developers use High-Level Methods and do not need this section.

Each API page includes:

  • the preferred high-level method, when one applies
  • a readable function contract
  • parameters and return information
  • a Clarion example

API functions

Function High-level method Purpose
TOML_GetLicenseMode ReadLicenseMode Returns the current runtime mode: 0 blocked, 1 demo, or 2 licensed.
TOML_GetLicenseStatusCode ReadLicenseStatusCode Returns the current license status code from the license manager.
TOML_InitLicense InitializeLicense Initializes the runtime license state. Returns 0 for demo mode, 1 for licensed mode, or -1 if blocked.
TOML_Free Close Releases a loaded TOML document and frees its associated memory.
TOML_Load LoadFile Loads a TOML file from disk and returns a handle for use in subsequent ProTOML calls.
TOML_LoadFromBuffer LoadBuffer Loads TOML from exact-length ANSI or UTF-8 bytes.
TOML_LoadFromString LoadText Parses a TOML document from an in-memory string buffer and returns a handle for subsequent ProTOML calls.
TOML_New NewDocument Creates a new empty in-memory TOML document.
TOML_Save SaveFile Saves a loaded TOML document back to disk.
TOML_SaveToBuffer SaveBuffer Serializes a document as ANSI or UTF-8 bytes.
TOML_SaveToString SaveText Serializes a loaded TOML document to a caller-supplied string buffer.
TOML_GetString GetString Returns a string value from a loaded TOML document.
TOML_GetStringBuffer GetString Gets a string using exact-length ANSI or UTF-8 buffers.
TOML_SetString SetString Sets a string value at the specified key path in a loaded TOML document.
TOML_SetStringBuffer SetString Sets a string using exact-length ANSI or UTF-8 buffers.
TOML_GetBool GetBool Returns a boolean value from a loaded TOML document as a LONG (1 = true, 0 = false).
TOML_GetDouble GetReal Returns a double-precision floating-point value for the Clarion REAL boundary.
TOML_GetFloat GetSReal Returns a single-precision floating-point value for the Clarion SREAL boundary.
TOML_GetInt GetLong Returns an integer value (LONG) from a loaded TOML document.
TOML_SetBool SetBool Sets a boolean value at the specified key path in a loaded TOML document.
TOML_SetDouble SetReal Sets a double-precision floating-point value from a Clarion REAL.
TOML_SetFloat SetSReal Sets a single-precision floating-point value from a Clarion SREAL.
TOML_SetInt SetLong Sets an integer value (LONG) at the specified key path in a loaded TOML document.
TOML_GetDateTimeCombined GetDateTimeText Returns a TOML datetime value into a Clarion SQL DateTime GROUP buffer (STRING(8) OVER structure).
TOML_GetDateTimeSeparate GetDateTimeText Returns a TOML datetime value as separate Clarion date (LONG) and time (LONG) values.
TOML_GetDateTimeString GetDateTimeText Returns TOML date or time text while preserving its TOML category and offset.
TOML_SetDateTimeCombined SetDateTimeText Sets a TOML datetime value from a Clarion SQL DateTime GROUP buffer (STRING(8) OVER structure).
TOML_SetDateTimeSeparate SetDateTimeText Sets a datetime value using separate Clarion date (LONG) and time (LONG) values.
TOML_SetDateTimeString SetDateTimeText Sets a TOML local or offset date/time value from TOML literal text.
TOML_ArrayAppendString AppendString Appends a string to a TOML array and returns the new zero-based index.
TOML_ArrayAppendStringBuffer AppendString Appends an ANSI or UTF-8 string to a simple TOML array.
TOML_ArrayAppendTable AppendTable Appends a table row to a TOML array of tables and returns the new zero-based index.
TOML_ArrayClear ClearArray Clears an existing array while preserving its kind. A missing key remains absent until the first append selects the array kind.
TOML_GetArrayCount GetArrayCount Returns the number of elements in a TOML array or array-of-tables at the specified key path.
TOML_GetArrayInt GetArrayLong Returns an integer value from a simple TOML array at the specified index.
TOML_GetArrayString GetArrayString Returns a string value from a simple TOML array at the specified index.
TOML_GetArrayStringBuffer GetArrayString Gets a string array element using exact-length ANSI or UTF-8 buffers.
TOML_GetLastErrorCode GetLastError Returns -1 if the last ProTOML operation failed, or 0 if it succeeded.
TOML_GetLastErrorText GetLastError Returns the error message from the most recent failed ProTOML operation.
TOML_KeyExists KeyExists Returns 1 if a key exists at the specified path in a loaded TOML document, 0 if not.
